generalAbilities.name: Temporal Sense
generalAbilities.description: A siktempora can always roll Dimension of Time Lore for initiative. When it does, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the roll.

hp.note: regeneration 40 (deactivated by mental, orichalcum, or spirit)

defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 40 (Deactivated by Mental, Orichalcum, or Spirit)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Foster Fear
defensiveAbilities.description: Creatures with the Frightened condition are always Off-Guard to the anguish siktempora.

defensiveAbilities.name: Uncanny Pounce
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The anguish siktempora rolls Dimension of Time Lore for initiative

Effect The siktempora Strides once and makes a jaws Strike, in either order.

offensiveAbilities.description:

A Rend entry lists a Strike the monster has.

Requirements The monster hit the same enemy with two consecutive Strikes of the listed type in the same round.

Effect The monster automatically deals that Strike's damage again to the enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scream of Despair
offensiveAbilities.description:
The anguish siktempora emits a terrible scream in a 30ft Emanation. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 33 Will Saving Throw save. The anguish siktempora can't use Scream of Despair for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d6 Mental Damage|options:area-damage]{2d6 mental damage, 2d6 sonic damage}, and is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature takes 6d6 Mental Damage|options:area-damage]{6d6 mental damage, 6d6 sonic damage}, and is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure As failure, but Frightened 3 and the creature gains weakness to mental 15 (this weakness applies to this Scream of Despair).

Effect: Scream of Despair

offensiveAbilities.name: Wracking Despair
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The anguish siktempora projects their crippling despair into the mind of a Frightened creature they can see within range of their telepathy. The frightened creature takes 6d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Will Saving Throw save).

lv4spells.name: Translocate (At Will)
lv4spells.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv7spells.name: Flicker
lv7spells.description:
You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

lv7spells.name: Fly (Constant)
lv7spells.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.
